description: Minimal capability for the live-preview window. It loads a TEAMMATE's running app served over the P2P tunnel (remote, semi-trusted content on a random localhost port), so it is deliberately scoped to the bare minimum a previewed web app needs — currently just the notification plugin, so the app's permission check resolves instead of throwing an unhandled rejection. It intentionally does NOT grant custom commands, fs, process, or window/webview control: previewed code must not be able to reach the viewer's Tauri backend.
